note: Every panic boundary is an explicit reliability decision. A new `catch_unwind` needs an entry here with the failure it contains; `panic = "abort"` anywhere would make these boundaries dead code and is rejected by the guard.

boundaries.rationale: A panicking speedtest probe becomes a typed Failed outcome instead of killing the scheduler.
A panicking version installer is reported as an Internal failure and the install slot is released.
A panicking background task moves the scheduler to WorkerFailed instead of unwinding the worker thread.
Writing the sanitized crash report after a panic must not panic again during teardown.
Emergency cleanup runs every registered hook even when an earlier hook panics.
